{"key":"req-0001","response":{"candidates":[{"index":0,"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n\n  // Step 1: Check standard preconditions.\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n\n  // If solver-\u003estable is true, return the existing reluctant doubling trigger logic.\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Step 2: Maintain a static float variable prev_fast_glue (init to 0).\n  // We use double to match the precision of Kissat's averages.\n  static double prev_fast_glue = 0.0;\n\n  // Retrieve current fast_glue and slow_glue.\n  const double fast_glue = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow_glue = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 3: Calculate velocity.\n  const double velocity = fast_glue - prev_fast_glue;\n\n  // Update prev_fast_glue.\n  prev_fast_glue = fast_glue;\n\n  // Step 4: Calculate a trend-adaptive modifier kappa.\n  const double kappa = 1.0 - velocity;\n\n  // Determine the baseline condition.\n  // Using standard restart margin option to approximate solver-\u003ebounds.restart.margin\n  const double margin = (100.0 + GET_OPTION (restartmargin)) / 100.0;\n  const bool trigger = (fast_glue \u003e slow_glue * margin * kappa);\n\n  // Step 5: Apply modulation.\n  // If velocity \u003c -0.02 (LBD improving), return false to suppress restart.\n  if (velocity \u003c -0.02)\n    return false;\n\n  // If velocity \u003e 0.05 (LBD degrading rapidly), return true to force early restart.\n  if (velocity \u003e 0.05)\n    return true;\n\n  // Step 6: Otherwise, return trigger.\n  return trigger;\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}]},"finishReason":"STOP"}],"usageMetadata":{"candidatesTokenCount":483,"thoughtsTokenCount":6088,"promptTokenCount":5871,"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":5871,"modality":"TEXT"}],"totalTokenCount":12442},"modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","responseId":"HNaKadrXKJ-Hz7IPs93FyQQ"},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview"}
